name: Chutian Dragon Co., Ltd.
summary: Chutian Dragon Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in digital security and services, intelligent hardware and integrated solutions, and system platforms and operational services in China and internationally. The company offers embedded security products, including smart cards, and embedded SIM; smart hardware, an organic combination of software and hardware products; and other software and service solutions.
